lines.text: On the rocky climb, Owen carried his water bottle in one hand.
Every time the trail got steep, he had only one hand left for the rock.
Slide the bottle into an insulated sleeve on a shoulder strap and wear it across your body.
Both hands stay free, the water stays at your hip,
and the neoprene slows it from freezing.
He reached the top with both hands.
Save this before your next climb.
